Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649943. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
